capabilities: Browse Zotero annotations in a sidebar
Quote annotations into notes with PDF links
extras: Requires Zotero 10 with the Local API enabled in Zotero's settings. Connects only to Zotero locally (127.0.0.1:23119) and reads Zotero's data folder read-only; nothing is sent to the internet. Full usage documentation is in docs/usage.md; interface available in English and Traditional Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in connection to Zotero, so pulling annotations and source PDFs into notes requires manual copying.

relations.evidence: A plugin connecting Zotero and Obsidian.

summary: Zotero integration for browsing annotations in a sidebar, quoting them into notes with PDF links, viewing and annotating PDFs, and editing Zotero notes.
